About

Rameesha Siddique

AI/ML Engineer

I am an Artificial Intelligence undergraduate at COMSATS University Islamabad, Attock Campus, with hands-on experience building systems across Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, NLP, and computer vision. My work starts with the actual constraint: a noisy document set, an Urdu language task, a video stream, or a question that needs a grounded answer.

I approach AI engineering as a combination of careful modeling, practical product thinking, and clear communication. Alongside freelance work and internships, I served as AI/ML Co-Lead at Google Developer Groups on Campus, supporting the student AI community through collaboration and knowledge sharing.
